scheme.signature: Ed25519 over the canonical bytes, raw standard base64 without padding
scheme.signed_payload: base64url without padding of the canonical bytes
scheme.seq: a JSON integer from 1 to 2^53-1 (not a float, not a boolean); the server requires it to be greater than the stored seq for the agent; it need not equal observed_at
scheme.agent: the subject's did:aw when it has one, otherwise its did:key
scheme.publisher_did: the signer's did:key; it must equal the designated status host
scheme.authenticated_signer: every case is published by publisher_did_key; the signature is verified with that authenticated key, and publisher_did must equal it
scheme.now: each case's evaluation time; stored_seq, when present, is the seq already stored for the agent
scheme.ordering: size is checked before parsing, canonical bytes before fields, and type before any other field; every other negative has exactly one fault
